title: Joy predloglari: qayerda?
goal_uz: Dars oxirida in, on, under, behind, next to, between kabi predloglar bilan narsa qayerdaligini aytasiz, “Where is ...?” deb so‘raysiz va rasm yoki xonani ingliz tilida tasvirlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Yigirma ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda olmoshlarni o‘rgandik: he, her, mine, theirs. Bugun narsa qayerda turganini aytishni o‘rganamiz: in, on, under, behind, between, next to. “Where is my phone?” deb so‘raymiz va rasmni tasvirlaymiz. Dars oxirida xonangizdagi sakkizta narsaning joyini ingliz tilida ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we practised pronouns. Today we say where things are.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar olmoshlarni mashq qildik. Bugun narsalar qayerda ekanini aytamiz.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha va inglizcha: tartib teskari

examples.t: The book is on the table.
The cat is in the room.

scenes.say_native: Joyni bildirishda ikkala til boshqacha ishlaydi. O‘zbek tilida ot oldin, joy so‘zi keyin keladi: “stol ustida”, “xonada”, “divan orqasida”. Bu joy so‘zlari otdan keyin turadi, shuning uchun ularni ko‘makchi yoki qo‘shimcha deymiz. Ingliz tilida esa teskari: joy so‘zi oldin, ot keyin. “On the table”, “in the room”, “behind the sofa”. Bunday so‘zlarni predloglar deymiz. Asosiy odat: avval predlog, keyin “the” va ot.
scenes.say: The book is on the table. The cat is in the room. The bag is behind the sofa.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob stol ustida. Mushuk xonada. Sumka divan orqasida.

scenes.title: In: ichida

examples.t: The keys are in the bag.
The milk is in the fridge.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi predlog: “in”. U biror narsaning ichida ekanini bildiradi. Quti ichida, sumka ichida, xona ichida: in the box, in the bag, in the room. O‘zbek tilida bu “-da” qo‘shimchasiga to‘g‘ri keladi: sumkada, xonada, muzlatkichda. Shunday qilib, agar narsa ichida bo‘lsa va uni yopiq joy deb tasavvur qilsangiz, “in” ishlating. Shaharlar va mamlakatlar ham “in” bilan keladi: in Tashkent, in London.
scenes.say: The keys are in the bag. The milk is in the fridge. My sister is in the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlar sumkada. Sut muzlatkichda. Singlim oshxonada.

scenes.title: On: ustida

examples.t: The book is on the table.
The picture is on the wall.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi predlog: “on”. U biror narsaning sirtida, ustida ekanini bildiradi va unga tegib turadi. On the table, on the floor, on the shelf. Devorga osilgan rasm ham devorga tegib turadi, shuning uchun “on the wall”. O‘zbek tilida “ustida”, “polda”, “devorda” kabi bir necha shaklga to‘g‘ri keladi. Esda tuting: in ichida, on sirtida. Bu ikki predlogni adashtirmaslik uchun ikki xil narsani tasavvur qiling: quti va stol.
scenes.say: The book is on the table. The picture is on the wall. The shoes are on the floor.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob stol ustida. Rasm devorda. Poyabzallar polda.

scenes.title: In yoki on
board: ✗ The book is in the table.
✓ The book is on the table.
✗ The cat is on the room.
✓ The cat is in the room.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tipik xato: “in the table”. O‘zbekcha “stolda” degan so‘zdagi “-da” ni “in” deb o‘ylab qo‘yamiz. Lekin kitob stolning ichida emas, sirtida turibdi, shuning uchun “on the table”. Teskarisi ham uchraydi: “on the room”. Xona narsalarni ichiga oladi, shuning uchun “in the room”. Har safar o‘zingizga savol bering: u narsa ichidami yoki sirtidami? Javob predlogni tanlab beradi.
scenes.say: The book is on the table. The cat is in the room. In is inside. On is on top.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob stol ustida. Mushuk xonada. In ichida. On ustida.

scenes.title: Under: tagida

examples.t: The cat is under the chair.
The shoes are under the bed.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi predlog: “under”. U biror narsaning tagida, pastida ekanini bildiradi. Under the table, under the bed, under the chair. O‘zbekcha “tagida” yoki “ostida” deymiz. Masalan, “The shoes are under the bed” — poyabzallar karavot tagida. Bu so‘z juda oddiy, adashish ehtimoli kam. Faqat talaffuzda e’tibor bering: “under” so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, ya’ni “UN-der”, oxiridagi “er” esa juda yengil.
scenes.say: The cat is under the chair. The shoes are under the bed. The bag is under the table.
scenes.say_uz: Mushuk stul tagida. Poyabzallar karavot tagida. Sumka stol tagida.

scenes.title: Behind va in front of

examples.t: The dog is behind the sofa.
The car is in front of the house.

scenes.say_native: Yana ikki predlog. “Behind” — orqasida: behind the sofa, behind the door. “In front of” — oldida: in front of the TV, in front of the house. Diqqat qiling: “in front of” uch so‘zdan iborat, va oxirida “of” bor. O‘zbek tilida “orqasida” va “oldida” bitta so‘z, ingliz tilida esa birinchisi bitta, ikkinchisi uchta. “Behind” ning ham, “in front of” ning ham qarama-qarshisi bor: behind — in front of.
scenes.say: The dog is behind the sofa. The car is in front of the house. The bag is behind the door.
scenes.say_uz: It divan orqasida. Mashina uyning oldida. Sumka eshik orqasida.

scenes.title: Behind of, in front the
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “behind of”. O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha “ning orqasida” deymiz, shu sabab “of” qo‘shib yuboramiz. Ingliz tilida “behind the sofa”, “of” kerak emas. Ikkinchisi teskarisi: “in front the house”, bu yerda “of” yetishmaydi. To‘g‘risi “in front of”. Uchinchisi: “next of”, aslida “next to”. Bu uch iborani to‘g‘ri shaklda o‘zingizga takrorlang.
scenes.say: Behind the sofa. In front of the house. Next to the bank.
scenes.say_uz: Divan orqasida. Uyning oldida. Bank yonida.

scenes.title: Next to, near, between, opposite
board: between the bank and the shop

examples.t: The shop is next to the bank.
The school is opposite the park.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtta predlog yana. “Next to” — yonida, tegib turgan holda: next to the bank. “Near” — yaqinida, biroz masofada: near the park. “Between” — orasida, va u doim ikkita narsani talab qiladi: between the bank and the shop. “Opposite” — qarshisida, yo‘lning narigi tomonida: opposite the school. Bularning hammasi o‘zbek tilida ham bor, faqat tartib teskari. Ingliz tilida predlog oldin, keyin joy nomi.
scenes.say: The shop is next to the bank. The park is near here. The cafe is between the bank and the shop. The school is opposite the park.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘kon bank yonida. Bog‘ shu yaqinda. Kafe bank va do‘kon orasida. Maktab bog‘ qarshisida.

scenes.title: Between faqat ikkita narsa o‘rtasida
board: ✗ The cat is between the table.
✓ The cat is between the table and the chair.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda xato odatda “between” ga bitta narsa qo‘yishdan chiqadi. “Orasida” degan so‘z o‘zbekchada bitta ot bilan ham bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan, “stullar orasida”. Ingliz tilida esa “between” ikkita aniq narsani talab qiladi, ular “and” bilan bog‘lanadi: between the table and the chair. Yoki “between the two chairs”. “Of” bu yerda ham ortiqcha. Bitta narsa haqida gapirsangiz, “between” emas, boshqa predlog tanlang.
scenes.say: The cat is between the table and the chair. The ball is between the two chairs.
scenes.say_uz: Mushuk stol va stul orasida. To‘p ikkita stul orasida.

scenes.title: Rasmga qarang
board: Picture: a lamp on the table
a ball between the sofa and the chair
scenes.say_native: Rasmni tasavvur qiling. Stol ustida chiroq turibdi. Stol tagida mushuk yotibdi. Sumka divan orqasida. To‘p esa divan bilan stul orasida. Endi uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: where is the lamp? Ikkinchi: where is the cat? Uchinchi: where is the ball? To‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Look at the picture. A lamp on the table. A cat under the table. A ball between the sofa and the chair. Where is the lamp? Where is the cat? Where is the ball?
scenes.say_uz: Rasmga qarang. Stol ustida chiroq. Stol tagida mushuk. To‘p divan va stul orasida. Chiroq qayerda? Mushuk qayerda? To‘p qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The lamp is on the table.
The cat is under the table.
The ball is between the sofa and the chair.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Chiroq stol ustida: “The lamp is on the table”. Mushuk stol tagida: “The cat is under the table”. To‘p divan va stul orasida: “The ball is between the sofa and the chair”. Gap tuzilishiga qarang: ega, “is”, predlog, “the” va joy nomi. Hammasida shu bir xil. Bu tuzilmani yodlab olsangiz, istalgan narsaning joyini ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: The lamp is on the table. The cat is under the table. The ball is between the sofa and the chair.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroq stol ustida. Mushuk stol tagida. To‘p divan va stul orasida.

scenes.title: Where is ...? Where are ...?
board: Where is the cat? → It's on the sofa.
Where are the keys? → They're in the bag.

examples.t: Where is my phone? It's on the bed.
Where are my glasses? They're on the shelf.

scenes.say_native: Narsa qayerdaligini so‘rash uchun “Where is” yoki “Where are” ishlatamiz. Bitta narsa bo‘lsa “Where is the cat?”, ko‘p bo‘lsa “Where are the keys?”. Qisqa shakl: “Where’s my phone?”. Javobda olmosh: “It’s on the bed” yoki “They’re in the bag”. O‘tgan darsda o‘rganganingizdek, bitta narsa uchun “it”, ko‘plik uchun “they”. Savol tartibi: Where, keyin is yoki are, keyin ega. O‘zbekchada fe’l oxirida, ingliz tilida esa ikkinchi o‘rinda.
scenes.say: Where is the cat? It's on the sofa. Where are the keys? They're in the bag. Where's my phone?
scenes.say_uz: Mushuk qayerda? U divan ustida. Kalitlar qayerda? Ular sumkada. Telefonim qani?

scenes.title: Where is my keys emas
board: ✗ He is on the table. (kitob haqida)
scenes.say_native: Savolda ikki xil xato bor. Birinchisi: ko‘plikdagi narsa uchun “is” ishlatish: “Where is my keys?”. Ko‘p narsa bo‘lsa “Where are my keys?”. Ikkinchisi: so‘z tartibi: “Where the cat is?”. Ingliz tilida savolda fe’l ega oldida keladi: “Where is the cat?”. Va javob berayotganda narsaga “he” yoki “she” demang, “it” deng. Bu qoidalarni oldingi darslarda ko‘rgan edik, bugun ularni joy bilan birlashtiramiz.
scenes.say: Where are my keys? Where is the cat? It is on the table.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlarim qani? Mushuk qayerda? U stol ustida.

scenes.title: Ha/yo‘q savollar
board: Is the cat under the table? Yes, it is.
Are the keys in the bag? No, they aren't.

examples.t: Is the book on the shelf? No, it isn't.
Are the keys in the bag? Yes, they are.

scenes.say_native: Joy haqida ha yoki yo‘q javobli savollar ham beramiz. Tuzilishi: Is yoki Are, ega, predlog. “Is the cat under the table?” Javob: “Yes, it is” yoki “No, it isn’t”. Ko‘plik uchun: “Are the keys in the bag?” “Yes, they are” yoki “No, they aren’t”. Yo‘q desangiz, ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri joyni ham aytasiz: “No, it isn’t. It’s on the sofa”. Bu suhbatni tabiiy qiladi va foydali.
scenes.say: Is the cat under the table? No, it isn't. It's on the sofa. Are the keys in the bag? Yes, they are.
scenes.say_uz: Mushuk stol tagidami? Yo‘q. U divan ustida. Kalitlar sumkadami? Ha.

scenes.title: Ha yoki yo‘q?
board: Picture: The book is on the shelf.
The keys are in the bag.
The cat is under the chair.
scenes.say_native: Yana rasm: kitob tokchada, kalitlar sumkada, mushuk stul tagida. Uchta savolga ha yoki yo‘q bilan javob bering. Birinchi: is the book on the table? Ikkinchi: are the keys in the bag? Uchinchi: is the cat on the chair? Agar javob yo‘q bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri joyni ham ayting.
scenes.say: Look: the book is on the shelf. The keys are in the bag. The cat is under the chair. Is the book on the table? Are the keys in the bag? Is the cat on the chair?
scenes.say_uz: Qarang: kitob tokchada. Kalitlar sumkada. Mushuk stul tagida. Kitob stol ustidami? Kalitlar sumkadami? Mushuk stul ustidami?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: No, it isn't. It's on the shelf.
No, it isn't. It's under the chair.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi savol: kitob stol ustidami? “No, it isn’t. It’s on the shelf”. Ikkinchi: kalitlar sumkadami? “Yes, they are”. Uchinchi: mushuk stul ustidami? “No, it isn’t. It’s under the chair”. Yo‘q javobida “it isn’t” ni, ha javobida “they are” ni qisqartirmasdan ayting, ya’ni “Yes, they’re” demang. Qisqa javoblarda “are” oxirida to‘liq o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: No, it isn't. It's on the shelf. Yes, they are. No, it isn't. It's under the chair.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q. U tokchada. Ha. Yo‘q. U stul tagida.

scenes.title: At home, at school, at work

examples.t: My mother is at work.
I am at home.

scenes.say_native: Bitta muhim predlog yana: “at”. U aniq nuqtani yoki odam odatda shug‘ullanadigan joyni bildiradi. At home, at school, at work, at the bus stop. O‘zbekchada “uyda”, “maktabda”, “ishda” deymiz, hammasi “-da”. Ingliz tilida esa bu odatiy joylar uchun “at”. Katta joylar uchun, masalan shahar yoki mamlakat, “in”: in London, in Uzbekistan. Xonalar uchun ham “in”: in the kitchen. Tanlash qiyin bo‘lsa, shu uch qoidani eslang.
scenes.say: I am at home. My mother is at work. The children are at school. We live in London.
scenes.say_uz: Men uydaman. Onam ishda. Bolalar maktabda. Biz Londonda yashaymiz.

scenes.title: In home emas, at home
scenes.say_native: Mana juda keng tarqalgan xato: “in home”. “Uyda” degan so‘zni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girsak, “in home” chiqadi. Lekin inglizlar “at home” deydi. Xuddi shunday “at work” va “at school”. “In school” desangiz ham tushunishadi, lekin odatiy emas va Britaniya ingliz tilida g‘alati eshitiladi. Qoida: odam odatdagi joyda bo‘lsa, at home, at work, at school. Binoning ichidagi xona uchun esa “in the kitchen”, “in the bedroom”.
scenes.say: I am at home. She is at work. The children are at school. I am in the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Men uydaman. U ishda. Bolalar maktabda. Men oshxonadaman.

scenes.title: Chap, o‘ng, o‘rta, burchak
board: on the left / on the right
at the top / at the bottom

examples.t: The lamp is on the left.
The plant is in the corner.

scenes.say_native: Rasmni tasvirlashda yana to‘rtta ibora kerak. “On the left” — chapda, “on the right” — o‘ngda. “In the middle” — o‘rtada. “In the corner” — burchakda. Rasmning tepasi “at the top”, pasti “at the bottom”. Diqqat qiling: chap va o‘ng uchun “on”, o‘rta va burchak uchun “in”. Bu kichik farqni yodlab oling, chunki rasm tasviri deyarli har doim shu so‘zlardan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: The lamp is on the left. The sofa is in the middle. The plant is in the corner. The picture is at the top.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroq chapda. Divan o‘rtada. Gul burchakda. Rasm tepada.

scenes.title: Rasmni qanday tasvirlaymiz
board: In the picture there is ... / there are ...
On the left there is ... , on the right ...

examples.t: In the picture there is a sofa and two chairs.
examples.uz: Rasmda divan va ikkita stul bor.

examples.t: On the right there are two plants.

scenes.say_native: Rasmni tasvirlash uchun uch qadam bor. Birinchi: rasm nima haqida: “It’s a living room”. Ikkinchi: asosiy narsalar, “there is” va “there are” bilan: “In the picture there is a sofa and two chairs”. Uchinchi: har bir narsaning joyi: “On the left there is a lamp”, “On the right there are two plants”. “There is” va “there are” ni oldingi darsda o‘rgandik, bugun ularga joyni qo‘shamiz. Tartib: umumiy, keyin tafsilot.
scenes.say: It's a living room. In the picture there is a sofa and two chairs. On the left there is a lamp. On the right there are two plants.
scenes.say_uz: Bu mehmonxona. Rasmda divan va ikkita stul bor. Chapda chiroq bor. O‘ngda ikkita gul bor.

scenes.title: Rasmni tasvirlang
board: lamp + phone — on the table, next to the bed
picture — on the wall, above the bed
scenes.say_native: Yotoqxona rasmini tasvirlang. Karavot o‘rtada. Karavot yonidagi stol ustida chiroq va telefon bor. Karavot tagida sumka. Devorda rasm osilgan. Hech bo‘lmasa to‘rtta gap ayting: “It’s a bedroom. There is a bed in the middle…”. Joy predloglarini ishlating va ko‘plikka e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Describe the bedroom. There is a bed in the middle. There is a table next to the bed. Lamp and phone on the table. Bag under the bed.
scenes.say_uz: Yotoqxonani tasvirlang. O‘rtada karavot bor. Karavot yonida stol bor. Stol ustida chiroq va telefon. Karavot tagida sumka.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: There is a bed in the middle.
There is a lamp and a phone on the table next to the bed.
There is a bag under the bed.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “It’s a bedroom. There is a bed in the middle. There is a table next to the bed. On the table there is a lamp and a phone. There is a bag under the bed. There is a picture on the wall.” Qarang, hammasi bir xil tuzilmada: there is, narsa, predlog, joy. Agar sizda bundan farqli lekin to‘g‘ri gaplar bo‘lsa, ham juda yaxshi. Muhim narsa: is va are, a yoki ko‘plik, va joy predlogi.
scenes.say: It's a bedroom. There is a bed in the middle. On the table there is a lamp and a phone. There is a bag under the bed.
scenes.say_uz: Bu yotoqxona. O‘rtada karavot bor. Stol ustida chiroq va telefon bor. Karavot tagida sumka bor.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: predloglar kuchsiz aytiladi

examples.t: It's next to the bank.
It's between the shop and the bank.

scenes.say_native: Predloglar odatda kuchsiz aytiladi, chunki muhim ma’noni narsa nomi tashiydi. “In front of” da “of” juda yengil, “əv” yoki hatto “ə”. “Next to” da ikki “t” yonma-yon, shuning uchun “next” dagi “t” aytilmaydi: “neks tə”. “Between” va “behind” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: be-TWEEN, be-HIND. “Under” va “opposite” da birinchi bo‘g‘inda: UN-der, OP-o-zit. Tez-tez ishlatiladigan bu so‘zlarni to‘g‘ri aytsangiz, nutqingiz ancha tabiiy chiqadi.
scenes.say: In front of the house. Next to the bank. Between the shop and the bank. Behind the sofa.
scenes.say_uz: Uyning oldida. Bank yonida. Do‘kon va bank orasida. Divan orqasida.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: between the shop and the bank
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. In front of the house, bu yerda “of” yengil. Next to the bank, “t” tushib qoladi. Between the shop and the bank, urg‘u TWEEN da. Behind the sofa, urg‘u HIND da. Har bir ibora uchun men aytganimdan keyin takrorlang. Shoshilmang, lekin oxirigacha aniq ayting va predloglarni yengil, otlarni esa aniq o‘qing.
scenes.say: In front of the house. Next to the bank. Between the shop and the bank. Behind the sofa.
scenes.say_uz: Uyning oldida. Bank yonida. Do‘kon va bank orasida. Divan orqasida.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring: “in front of” da “of” yengil aytildimi? “Next to” da “t” tushib qoldimi, “neks tə”? “Between” da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inga, “behind” da ham ikkinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u berdingizmi? Agar ha bo‘lsa, ajoyib. Yana shuni ham aytay: gap o‘rtasida “the” ham yengil, “ðə” aytiladi. Predlog, “the”, ot ketma-ketligi bir bo‘g‘indek ravon eshitilishi kerak: “on the table”.
scenes.say: On the table. In the bag. Under the chair. Behind the door.
scenes.say_uz: Stol ustida. Sumkada. Stul tagida. Eshik orqasida.

scenes.title: Tinglang: kalitlar qani?
board: A: Mum, where are my keys?
B: They're on the table, next to the lamp.
B: Look in your bag. A: Oh, here they are! They're under my book.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. O‘g‘il onasidan kalitlari qayerdaligini so‘raydi. Ona avval stol ustida, chiroq yonida deydi, lekin kalitlar u yerda emas. Keyin ona sumkaga qarashni maslahat beradi. Diqqat qiling: on, next to, in, under. Savollar: ona avval kalitlar qayerda deb o‘ylaydi? Ular aslida qayerda? Qaysi narsa ularning ustida turibdi?
scenes.say: Mum, where are my keys? They're on the table, next to the lamp. No, they aren't there. Look in your bag. Oh, here they are! They're under my book.
scenes.say_uz: Ona, kalitlarim qani? Ular stol ustida, chiroq yonida. Yo‘q, ular u yerda emas. Sumkangizga qarang. Mana, ular! Ular kitobim tagida.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) Where does Mum think the keys are?
2) Where does she say to look?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: ona avval kalitlar qayerda deb o‘ylaydi? Ikkinchi: u qayerga qarashni aytadi? Uchinchi: kalitlar aslida qayerda, ya’ni qaysi narsa tagida? Predloglardan foydalanib, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Masalan, “They’re …”.
scenes.say: Where does Mum think the keys are? Where does she say to look? Where are the keys really?
scenes.say_uz: Ona kalitlar qayerda deb o‘ylaydi? U qayerga qarashni aytadi? Kalitlar aslida qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) On the table, next to the lamp.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ona kalitlar stol ustida, chiroq yonida deb o‘ylaydi: “on the table, next to the lamp”. U sumkaga qarashni aytadi: “in your bag”. Kalitlar kitob tagida: “under my book”, va bu kitob sumkada deb tushunish mumkin. Bu yerda ayniqsa “your bag” va “my book” ga e’tibor bering: ular egalik sifatlari, o‘tgan darsda o‘rganilgan. Mana, bugungi va kechagi mavzu birlashdi.
scenes.say: On the table, next to the lamp. In your bag. Under my book.
scenes.say_uz: Stol ustida, chiroq yonida. Sumkangizda. Kitobim tagida.

scenes.title: Tinglang: bank qayerda?
board: A: Excuse me, where is the bank?
B: It's next to the post office, opposite the park.
B: Yes, it's between the cafe and the pharmacy.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sayyoh yo‘lovchidan bank qayerdaligini so‘raydi. U muloyim boshlaydi: “Excuse me”. Yo‘lovchi bankning joyini ikki xil tasvirlaydi. Diqqat qiling: next to, opposite, near, between. Savollar: bank nimaning yonida? U nimaning qarshisida? U yaqin joydami? Va kafe bilan dorixona orasida nima bor?
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the bank? It's next to the post office, opposite the park. Is it near here? Yes, it's between the cafe and the pharmacy.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, bank qayerda? U pochta yonida, bog‘ qarshisida. U shu yaqindami? Ha, u kafe va dorixona orasida.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring

scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: bank nimaning yonida? Ikkinchi: bank nimaning qarshisida? Uchinchi: u yaqin joydami? To‘rtinchi: kafe va dorixona orasida nima bor? Qisqa va aniq javob bering. Eslatma: dialogda “it” bank haqida, shuning uchun javobda ham “it” ishlating.
scenes.say: What is next to the bank? What is opposite the bank? Is it near? What is between the cafe and the pharmacy?
scenes.say_uz: Bank nimaning yonida? Bank nimaning qarshisida? U yaqinmi? Kafe va dorixona orasida nima bor?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bank pochtaning yonida: “the post office”. Bank bog‘ qarshisida: “the park”. U yaqinmi? “Yes, it is”. Kafe va dorixona orasida bank joylashgan: “the bank”. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta bank uchun to‘rtta predlog ishlatildi. Yo‘l so‘rashda ham, uyni tasvirlashda ham shu iboralar kerak bo‘ladi, shuning uchun ularni qayta-qayta takrorlang.
scenes.say: The post office. The park. Yes, it is. The bank.
scenes.say_uz: Pochta. Bog‘. Ha. Bank.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadan inglizchaga
scenes.say_native: Mana oxirgi grammatik mashq. To‘rtta o‘zbekcha gapni inglizchaga o‘giring. Kitob stol ustida. Sumka karavot tagida. Mushuk divan orqasida. Men uydaman. Tartibni eslang: ega, is, predlog, the, ot. Va oxirgi gapda “at” ni o‘ylab ko‘ring. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Translate. The book is on the table. The bag is under the bed. The cat is behind the sofa. I am at home.
scenes.say_uz: Tarjima qiling. Kitob stol ustida. Sumka karavot tagida. Mushuk divan orqasida. Men uydaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The book is on the table.
The bag is under the bed.
The cat is behind the sofa.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “The book is on the table”, “The bag is under the bed”, “The cat is behind the sofa”, “I am at home”. Hammasida o‘zbekcha tartib teskari aylandi: ot oldin, joy so‘zi keyin emas, balki ega, is, predlog va keyin ot. Va “uyda” uchun “at home”. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, joy predloglarining asosini egallab oldingiz.
scenes.say: The book is on the table. The bag is under the bed. The cat is behind the sofa. I am at home.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob stol ustida. Sumka karavot tagida. Mushuk divan orqasida. Men uydaman.

scenes.title: Xonangizni tasvirlang
board: Use in, on, under, next to, between
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizning xonangizni tasvirlang. Kamida to‘rtta gap ayting. Karavot, stol, deraza, kitob, kompyuter yoki boshqa narsalar haqida. “There is a bed next to the window”, “My books are on the shelf”. Turli predloglarni ishlating: in, on, under, next to yoki between. Rasmni tasavvur qiling va ravon ayting.
scenes.say: Now describe your room. Use there is, there are, and prepositions. Four or five sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Endi xonangizni tasvirlang. There is, there are va predloglarni ishlating. To‘rt-beshta gap.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: There is a bed next to the window.
My books are on the shelf.
My bag is under the desk.
The laptop is on the desk, between the lamp and the cup.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “There is a bed next to the window. There is a desk in the corner. My books are on the shelf. My bag is under the desk. The laptop is on the desk, between the lamp and the cup.” Siz bu yerda there is, my va predloglardan bir vaqtning o‘zida foydalandingiz. O‘zingizdan gap tuzgan bo‘lsangiz, aynan shunday tuzilmada bo‘lishi kerak. Shu bilan bugungi asosiy ko‘nikma tayyor.
scenes.say: There is a bed next to the window. My books are on the shelf. My bag is under the desk. The laptop is between the lamp and the cup.
scenes.say_uz: Deraza yonida karavot bor. Kitoblarim tokchada. Sumkam stol tagida. Noutbuk chiroq va chashka orasida.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: in, on, under, behind, in front of
next to, near, between ... and ..., opposite
at home / at work / at school
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: ingliz tilida joy so‘zi oldin, ot keyin: on the table. In ichida, on ustida, under tagida, behind orqasida, in front of oldida. Ikkinchi: next to, near, opposite, va between ikkita narsa orasida. Uchinchi: at home, at work, at school. To‘rtinchi: where is yoki where are bilan so‘raymiz, it yoki they bilan javob beramiz. Beshinchi: rasmni there is va there are bilan tasvirlaymiz.
scenes.say: Today: in, on, under, behind, next to, between, at home, and Where is it?
scenes.say_uz: Bugun: in, on, under, behind, next to, between, at home va Where is it?

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Homework: describe where 8 objects are in your room
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: xonangizdagi sakkizta narsaning joyini ingliz tilida yozing va baland ovozda ayting. Mezon: sakkizta gap, kamida beshta turli predlog, kamida bitta “between … and …”, bitta “there are” va bitta “Where is …?” savoli bo‘lsin. “In home” kabi xato bo‘lmasin. Keyingi darsda transport va chipta olishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: write eight sentences about where things are in your room. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: xonangizdagi sakkizta narsaning joyini yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Xonangizdagi 8 ta narsaning qayerdaligini ingliz tilida yozing: masalan, “My books are on the shelf. The bag is under the desk.” Mezon: 8 ta gap, kamida 5 ta turli predlog, kamida bitta between ... and ..., bitta there are va bitta “Where is ...?” savoli bo‘lsin; “in home” kabi xato bo‘lmasin. Gaplarni baland ovozda o‘qing. Keyingi darsda transport va chipta olishni o‘rganamiz.
